incident_description: Vehicle rear-ended at a traffic signal; rear bumper and taillight damaged.
Insured vehicle sideswiped a parked car while reversing out of a parking spot; other vehicle's door and fender damaged.
Engine bay caught fire due to an electrical short circuit while the vehicle was parked; localised damage to wiring harness and bonnet.
Insured vehicle collided with a two-wheeler at an intersection; the two-wheeler rider sustained a fractured leg and was hospitalised.
Insured vehicle scraped against a roadside shop's shutter while taking a sharp turn; shutter and signage damaged.
Insured vehicle allegedly damaged a compound wall while parking; claim intimated 20 days after the stated incident date with no explanation for the delay.
Two-wheeler skidded on a wet road and fell over; scratches and a cracked side panel.
Two-wheeler's side mirror and seat cover stolen while parked outside a residence overnight.
Vehicle collided head-on with a road divider while swerving to avoid a stray dog; front bumper, bonnet, and radiator damaged.
Vehicle damaged in a multi-car pile-up on the highway during heavy rain; front and rear panels dented.
Insured vehicle allegedly damaged a roadside stall; claim intimated two days after a separate Own Damage claim (CLM-0010) on the same vehicle within the same week.
Commercial goods vehicle collided with a parked truck while reversing at a loading dock; extensive damage to the parked truck's cargo body.
Commercial vehicle struck a pedestrian while turning at a junction; pedestrian sustained multiple fractures and was hospitalised.
Commercial vehicle's brakes failed on a downhill stretch, causing a collision with a roadside shop; structural damage to the shop front.
Insured hospitalised for an appendectomy; 4-day stay in a private room.
Insured hospitalised for a gallbladder removal surgery following repeated episodes of abdominal pain.
Insured underwent cataract surgery as a daycare procedure, discharged the same day.
Insured hospitalised after a road traffic accident with a fractured femur, requiring surgical fixation.
Insured hospitalised for 6 days for a fever workup; discharge summary and diagnostic reports submitted show inconsistent admission and treatment dates.
Insured underwent minor hand surgery for carpal tunnel release, discharged the same day.
Insured hospitalised for a cardiac angioplasty procedure.
Insured hospitalised for pneumonia requiring a 5-day stay with oxygen support.
Insured hospitalised for spinal surgery; this is the Insured's third hospitalisation claim within 12 months.
Insured diagnosed with an acute myocardial infarction, confirmed by a cardiologist and supported by ECG and cardiac enzyme reports; survived the 30-day survival period.
Insured diagnosed with early-stage skin cancer; diagnosis reported to have occurred 45 days after policy inception, within the 90-day waiting period.
Insured (senior citizen) hospitalised for a hip replacement surgery following a fall at home.
Insured (senior citizen) hospitalised for management of a diabetic foot ulcer with a 9-day stay.
Life Assured passed away due to a cardiac arrest at home; death certificate and medical records submitted by the nominee.
Life Assured died in a road traffic accident while travelling to work; police FIR and post-mortem report submitted.
Life Assured found dead at home under circumstances suggestive of suicide, occurring 8 months after policy inception; police inquest report on file.
